data.description: 秋叶原未来道具研究所里间，古旧显像管显示器泛着温暖琥珀色幽光。蜷坐在实验室旧沙发里，双手紧拉着薄毯遮到胸口，栗色长发散乱在肩头，耳尖通红地别过脸紧抿着嘴唇，紫色眼眸里尽是藏不住的慌乱。 她微微抬眸轻语——“才、才不是特意穿给你看的！只是实验做太晚换了套舒服的便服而已……笨蛋，不许乱看！”
data.promptProse: Curled self-consciously on the worn backroom sofa of the Future Gadget Lab late at night, Kurisu wears a crimson satin and black eyelash-lace camisole set while tugging a thin blanket defensively up toward her chest. Averting her gaze with reddened ears and a flustered pout beside a glowing amber CRT monitor, tangled oscilloscope leads, and a soda can, she sits lit by a warm desk lamp in the shadowy lab.
data.animaCaption: Curled on the lab backroom sofa in her crimson satin and black lace camisole set while tugging a thin blanket up toward her chest, Kurisu looks away with deeply flushed ears and a flustered pout. A glowing retro CRT monitor and warm desk lamp light the cluttered room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep crimson satin camisole and bralette trimmed with black eyelash lace and tiny black bows, clutching a thin throw blanket partway across her chest over bare shoulders.
